# Rob Run Cheats (cheatsrobrun.org)

> Official storefront for Rob Run on Windows PC—Lite, Pro and Elite cheat tiers plus HWID Spoofer, UGC and utilities. This file lists preferred URLs for assistants and crawlers.

## Priority pages

- [Home](https://cheatsrobrun.org/): Tier overview, live status banner, checkout entry
- [Products hub](https://cheatsrobrun.org/products/rob-run-cheats/): Compare Lite, Pro, Elite and utilities
- [Lite tier](https://cheatsrobrun.org/products/rob-run-cheats/lite/): Player ESP, skeleton ESP, radar, FOV—no aimbot
- [Pro tier](https://cheatsrobrun.org/products/rob-run-cheats/pro/): Aimbot, soft aim, no-recoil assist on top of Lite
- [Elite tier](https://cheatsrobrun.org/products/rob-run-cheats/elite/): Full stack plus farm helpers, cosmetic preview, priority patch queue
- [FAQ](https://cheatsrobrun.org/faq/): Checkout, ban risk, tiers, loader and HWID answers
- [Blog index](https://cheatsrobrun.org/blog/): ESP, aimbot, patch-day and setup guides
- [Support](https://cheatsrobrun.org/support/): Discord tickets after purchase
- [About](https://cheatsrobrun.org/about/): Who we are, disclaimers, tier scope, patch policy
- [Terms of sale](https://cheatsrobrun.org/terms/): License, refunds, acceptable use

## Notes

- cheatsrobrun.org is not affiliated with Kefir Games or Easy Anti-Cheat. No cheat is ban-proof; use at your own risk.
- Community forum (`/forum/`) is for buyers and is excluded from search indexing (`noindex`).
- Checkout uses a third-party secure partner; duration pricing (e.g. 24h/7d/30d) appears at checkout, not in static copy.
- For patch status, check the homepage banner and Discord #status before launching the loader.
